---
title: "List of figures and tables"
lof: true
lot: true
format: typst
_quarto:
  tests:
    typst:
      ensurePdfRegexMatches:
        - # Both lists are rendered with their entries, before the body
          - 'List of Figures[\s\S]*A figure caption[\s\S]*List of Tables[\s\S]*A table caption[\s\S]*Introduction'
          # The subfigure parent stays in the list
          - 'List of Figures[\s\S]*Parent with subfigures[\s\S]*List of Tables'
          # Cross-references to a subfigure keep their sub-numbering
          - 'See Figure 2a'
        - # Subfigure captions are not listed between the list title and the body
          - 'List of Figures[\s\S]*Subcaption A[\s\S]*Introduction'
---

# Introduction

With `lof: true` and `lot: true`, a list of figures and a list of tables are printed after the title block and before this heading, as in LaTeX output (#14081).

Subfigures are left out of the list of figures, as in LaTeX: only their parent is listed. A cross-reference to a subfigure still shows its sub-numbering.

See @fig-sub-a.

::: {#fig-one}

CONTENT

A figure caption

:::

:::: {#fig-sub layout-ncol=2}

::: {#fig-sub-a}

CONTENT A

Subcaption A

:::

::: {#fig-sub-b}

CONTENT B

Subcaption B

:::

Parent with subfigures

| a | b |
|---|---|
| 1 | 2 |
